findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base = 'ced38064d8bdd0325a022d2369602e5b34853be2'
paths = ['ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md', 'ops/devlane/task/CONTRACT.md']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', base], text=True).splitlines() == paths
for path in paths:
    old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{base}:{path}'], text=True)
    new = Path(path).read_text()
    assert re.findall(r'```[^\n]*\n.*?```', old, re.S) == re.findall(r'```[^\n]*\n.*?```', new, re.S)
    if '/dispatch/' in path:
        assert old.split('### Attempt admission and custody', 1)[1] == new.split('### Attempt admission and custody', 1)[1]
    else:
        assert old.split('### C2 standing and declaration schema', 1)[0] == new.split('### C2 standing and declaration schema', 1)[0]
task = Path(paths[1]).read_text()
native = json.loads(re.findall(r'```json\n(.*?)```', task, re.S)[2])
rendered = 'Declared job outputs:\n'
for entry in native['check-tests']:
    p = json.dumps('/jobs/example/out/' + entry['path'])
    if entry['kind'] == 'file':
        rendered += f'Required file: {p}. Write a non-empty document; set artifacts[{json.dumps(entry["artifact"])}] to {p}.\n'
    else:
        rendered += f'Scratch subtree: {p}. Temporary work only; no artifact is required; TMPDIR is {p}.\n'
assert rendered in task
for entries in native.values():
    names = [e['path'] for e in entries] + ['last-message.json', 'COMMIT_MSG']
    assert len(names) == len(set(names))
    assert not any(a.startswith(b + '/') for a in names for b in names if a != b)
